Section heading: Linear correlation of the two treatments with the reference values

All correlation coefficients in this section are rounded to two decimal places.

Figure 3 title: Measured values versus reference values for treatments A and B.

What Figure 3 actually shows: The x-axis is the reference value (mm), the y-axis is the measured value (mm), and the legend distinguishes treatments A and B. In-figure labels give |r| = 0.92 for treatment A and |r| = 0.73 for treatment B. The figure does not show a causal mechanism.

Sentence citing the figure: The absolute correlation coefficients for treatments A and B were 0.92 and 0.72, respectively (Figure 3).
